question: 按客户等级统计 2015 年成交量，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dc.Tier AS tier, SUM(ft.Quantity) AS total_trade_quantity FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2015 GROUP BY dc.Tier ORDER BY total_trade_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: Tier 是客户的分层属性
成交量是证券交易数量的合计
